Description.SourceString:
Fermented with wild anima, this potion is a concentrated and more powerful version of its predecessor. The effects last longer and yet the power of the potion loses none of its efficiency.

Be warned, after drinking this potion, you may find yourself dreaming of assembling furniture, painting little clay decorations, and a billion other little crafty things that you would never have dreamed of before.

Just beware not to dream of the forbidden macramé, for in its strange knots do dark secrets dwell.
